Name: --Outdated-- Witch name for Wizard mod by CreepyKat
Author: Novatius
Description:
[b][size=4]As stated in the title, this mod is outdated now. You may come to find that it's not a Content Patcher version, whether that matters or not to you, and it may or may not be as accurate, or even functional anymore, due to game updates. I've kind of left Stardew as a whole (Not that I don't like the game, just kinda got stale after a bit), and this entails modding, so I can't really make any needed changes. However, that should be changed for the better now, a user by the name of Lineyakitty has published [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3205]an updated version of this concept[/url]﻿, and you may find that here. It's Content Patcher and all, so be sure to check that one out and use it instead; of course, unless you prefer this one. Happy modding everyone, and happy new year.[/size]
[/b]





This is a very minor change to compliment [url=http://nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1011/?]the mod made by CreepyKat that turns the Wizard into a female; a Witch[/url]. What I changed is the name of the Wizard to say "Witch" during NPC chat windows. The description of CreepyKat's mod seemed as if they wanted to know how to change the Wizard's name. I told them how they could do so, but then decided to do it myself as a friendly gesture.

This will also include an optional file that makes an adjustment to the Wizard's dialogue that switches the Wizard's story about his wife running rampant after they had split up. It will change to say "Husband" and "He" where needed, to conform to the Wizard now being female. Leave out of you wish to imagine the Witch as same sex sexuality.

Side note; if you have other mods that change the names of NPCs, this mod WILL revert them back to their normal name. For example, a name mod that turns say, Sebastian's name to something like "Sebby," it will be changed to Sebastian again. There's nothing I can really do about this given that it would require many custom-made patches, and I don't have the time to fulfill those on a normal basis.
